metadata.source_note: Bounded context excerpt from the unchanged full official PDF retained in the parentage-history scope. Only original PDF pages 1 and 26 (printed pages 2942 and 2967) are extracted by the existing page_windows pipeline. The first page introduces BGB 1591; the final page contains Article 17 section 1 commencement. This is not a complete-act capture, does not replace the full 26-page source, and does not claim that intervening amendment/transition provisions are irrelevant. Exact operative maternity and commencement spans are visually verified in the original retained images. Other OCR limitations remain disclosed.
